title: Mac Explorer — Open-source Mac File Manager for macOS
description: Mac Explorer is an open-source Mac file manager with split panes, vertical tabs, tab groups, gallery and quick previews, PDF & OCR search, batch rename, Git actions, SFTP and LocalSend for Apple Silicon and Intel.
appStoreDownload: Get it on the App Store
eyebrow: MADE FOR macOS · FREE & OPEN SOURCE
faqTitle: A few things before you start
faqs: Mac Explorer is an open-source Mac file manager for macOS. It brings split panes, vertical tabs, workspace groups, instant previews, content search and transfers into one window.
Requires macOS 14 or later, on Apple Silicon or Intel.
How do the website and App Store editions differ?

The website edition is free and open source, with plugins, scripts and terminal actions. The App Store edition uses a subscription and system folder authorization. See its store listing for features and pricing.
Are my files and search data uploaded?

File indexes, tags and image recognition results stay on your Mac. Optional location lookup, user-configured AI services and file transfers connect to the corresponding services or selected devices. See the privacy policy for details.
endText: Found a bug or have a feature in mind? Open an issue on GitHub. To build your own plugin, start with the SDK.
guideCtaTitle: Try Mac Explorer on your Mac
guideCtaText: Split panes, batch rename previews and content search, all in one window.
footerLine: A file manager made for macOS.
intro: A file manager made for macOS. Browse, find, organize and share, all in one window.
browserAlt: Mac Explorer file list and context menus: stacked windows with built-in background themes, project browsing, editing, moving, sharing and file conversion, including toolbar tags and the right-hand information panel

capabilities.label: 01 / BROWSE & ORGANIZE
capabilities.title: Multiple folders. One workspace.
capabilities.intro: Bring files, folders and projects into a view that works for you.
items: Split panes, vertical tabs and groups

Work side by side in horizontal, vertical, three-pane or four-pane layouts, or switch to a hover-expanding vertical tab bar. Organize tabs into groups and save workspace presets to reopen layouts in one click.
Switch between list, icon, tree and gallery views. Resize thumbnails with the status bar slider, jump by typing initials, and narrow results with grouping, sorting and column filters.
See mounted drives, workspace groups, frequent folders and recent files on the Workbench. Organize with nested tags, ratings and tag filters without moving the original files.
Inspect sizes, dates, camera and photo metadata, and copy local SHA-256 hashes. Open Disk Management from the sidebar to check mounted volumes, formats and eject safely.

capabilities.label: 02 / SEARCH & PREVIEW
capabilities.title: A small clue. The right file.
capabilities.intro: Find what matters and see what’s inside without switching windows.
items: Press ⌘ K to find filenames, indexed PDF content and image OCR text. Preview the selected match right inside the panel or jump straight to its folder.
Browse photos by people, recognized text, scenes, dates and locations. Name groups of people, with image recognition on your device.
Press Space for images, PDFs, Office docs, archives and native video playback. Edit Markdown with live formatting, and inspect side-by-side Diff / Patch previews with line numbers.
Combine replacements, numbering, dates, templates and regular expressions. Preview every name, check conflicts, save presets and undo a completed batch.

capabilities.label: 03 / PROCESS & TRANSFER
capabilities.title: Keep your file work together.
capabilities.intro: From local operations to remote folders, stay in your flow.
items: Double-click ZIP, TAR, 7Z and other archives to browse inside and extract single items, or create encrypted ZIPs with custom compression levels. Convert documents to Word or PDF and resize images.

Track copy, move, transfer and extract jobs in the background queue or dedicated progress window with pause, resume and retry. Compare incoming and existing files side by side before skipping, replacing or keeping both.
SFTP, SMB, WebDAV and network discovery
Manage SFTP files and upload edits automatically. Mount SMB and WebDAV through macOS, manage network locations together, and discover and connect to local network servers.
Send files and folders from the context menu. Check the device and file list before receiving, or share selected items with AirDrop.

capabilities.label: 04 / YOUR WORKFLOW
capabilities.title: Make it work your way.
capabilities.intro: Keep everyday actions close, and make repetitive work easier.
items: Menu bar delivery and file staging

Browse Downloads, Desktop, custom folders and collections from the menu bar. Drag files or folders into the staging area to preview them, drag copies into other apps or clear the list. Originals stay in place; staging clears when you quit.
Use natural language to find files, organize selections, prepare renames or convert files. Review the plan before changes or content sharing.
Inspect Git diffs, commit history and stage changes right from the context menu. The website edition also supports a plugin market, local plugin packages and Workbench shell commands.
Pick built-in background themes, light or dark glass, and frosted or skeuomorphic folder covers. Resize and group sidebar items, customize shortcuts, and switch across four languages.
